lines.zh: : 反正我也很难拒绝你。我只是希望,你处理这件事的方式能……稍微换一换?

lines.en: scene gethimdrunk25
: Confronting someone about concerns is admirable or whatever, but when you’re trying to deceive them into giving you the information you want, it’s just...
lines.zh: : 出于担忧去当面质问,固然可敬什么的。但当你试图骗对方说出你想要的情报时,那就只是……

lines.en: : My head really hurts. I’m, like...dizzy.
lines.zh: : 我头真的很疼。我现在,那个……头晕。

lines.en: : It’s just not what I’d expect from you, Imani. Rika, sure. But you’re not the type to really-
lines.zh: : 这真的不像我会从你这里见到的,Imani。Rika 嘛,正常。但你不是那种真的会——

lines.en: scene gethimdrunk26
: Brlgh?!...
: Wait, you’re not going to throw up, are you? Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 等等,你不是要吐了吧?求你千万别。

lines.en: : Talk about convenient timing. It’s like a sign from the heavens that maybe confessing this to rational people is a bad idea.
lines.zh: : 时机真是巧妙。这就像上天的启示:也许,把这种事向理智的人坦白,本就是个坏主意。

lines.en: : Mmmngh?! Mmmgh??!?!
: Can you not even make it to the-
lines.zh: : 你连走到洗手——

lines.en: scene gethimdrunk27
: BLGHEHGFHRGHRGHGRLLHGHGMMGNHGH!!!!!!
lines.zh: : BLGHEHGFHRGHRGHGRLLHGHGMMGNHGH!!!!!!

lines.en: : ...bathroom.
lines.zh: : ……卫生间。

lines.en: : There, there...let it all out...it happens to the best of us...
lines.zh: : 好了好了……都吐出来……这种事谁都难免……

lines.en: scene gethimdrunk28
: Easy for you to say. You’re not the one being puked on.
lines.zh: : 你说得轻巧。被吐的又不是你。

lines.en: : Oh, Akira. When’d you get here?
lines.zh: : 哦,Akira。你什么时候到的?

lines.en: scene gethimdrunk29
: Oh god...
lines.zh: : 我的天……

lines.en: : There’s more...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: $ imanispring3 = True
$ imani_love += 1
jump rikaspring6
